title: Shut down the Mac immediately
summary: Turn off your Mac right now using the Terminal. This is useful if the menu is unresponsive or you want to ensure a clean power-off.

steps.explain: This command halts the system immediately, shutting down all processes and powering off the Mac.

rollback.explain: There is no command to undo an immediate shutdown once the power is cut. You must physically press the power button to turn the Mac back on.

warnings: All unsaved work will be lost.
This action cannot be undone via command line once executed.
